response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM type_shares) SELECT ts.tradekind, ts.transaction_count, ts.share, ts.share - a.share AS share_above_average FROM type_shares AS ts CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.share IS NOT NULL AND ts.share > a.share
